# blankcollar.ventures

> blankcollar.ventures is the startup guide of The Blank Collar: a free, educational resource that shows
> people starting a company how to use the Blank Collar Framework. It is not a fund, not an operating
> partner and not a paid service. It takes no applications, makes no investor introductions and sells
> nothing. English and German.

The Blank Collar Framework is a way to split a company's work between people and AI. It has five
variables (Vision, Data, Process, Human Experience, AI) and one output. The full version is on
https://www.theblankcollar.com/framework.

blankcollar.ventures is part of The Blank Collar. "Work is for bots. Life is for humans."
Defined in 2016 and founded in 2018 by Kristian Kabashi (Zürich, Switzerland). The sister sites hold
the material this guide points to: theblankcollar.com (the Framework and the book), blankcollar.ai
(the open-source agentic OS) and blankcollar.university (the free curriculum).

## Key facts
- Author: Kristian Kabashi, https://www.kristiankabashi.com
- Brand: The Blank Collar, https://www.theblankcollar.com
- Free to read. No signup, no application, no equity taken, no capital offered.
- Audience: people starting a company, and the teachers and mentors who work with them.
- The book "The Blank Collar" is free to read as EPUB and PDF, with no email asked:
  https://www.theblankcollar.com/book

## What the guide covers
- Why the material is free
- The four layers: Framework, startup guide, agentic OS, curriculum
- Eight of the 13 mental models from the Blank Collar Codex, one line each
- Five steps to use the Framework in your own company, at your own pace
